# PLACES — Administrative Office Real Estate in Egypt

> PLACES is Egypt's specialized real estate partner for administrative office space — helping businesses and investors buy, lease, or resell offices across Cairo's top business districts, with deep developer relationships and end-to-end advisory.

PLACES focuses exclusively on administrative (office) real estate. We work with most major Egyptian developers (SODIC, Emaar, Palm Hills, MARAKEZ, Misr Italia, and many others) and are not tied to any single one, so recommendations are based on client needs. Services cover tenant representation (office leasing on the tenant's side, free for tenants), primary (developer) purchases, resale, investment consultation, and income-generating property.

Locations served: New Cairo, Sheikh Zayed, 6th October, Downtown Cairo, Sheraton, and Maadi.

Contact: admin@places-egy.com · +20 106 361 8217

## Services
- [Tenant Representation](https://places-egy.com/services/tenant-representation): PLACES represents companies (not landlords) when they lease an office in Cairo: requirements brief, full-market search, viewings, negotiation and lease review. Free for tenants; the landlord pays the fee.
- [Primary Property](https://places-egy.com/services/primary-property): Buying offices directly from developers.
- [Property Resale](https://places-egy.com/services/property-resale): Buying and selling offices on the secondary market.
- [Investment Consultation](https://places-egy.com/services/investment-consultation): Advisory for office real estate investment decisions.
- [Income Generating Property](https://places-egy.com/services/income-generating-property): Leased, income-producing office assets.
